settings.show_logs_tab_hint: Adds a Logs tab with recent backend activity — useful for debugging a failed download
settings.max_concurrent_hint: How many downloads run at the same time ({{min}}–{{max}}). More is not always faster — sources rate-limit too.
settings.rate_limit_hint: 0 means unlimited. The limit applies per download, not to the app total — with {{concurrency}} running at once the combined speed can reach {{concurrency}}× this number.
settings.background_hint: Closing the window minimises to the system tray and downloads keep going.

history.subtitle: Manage and access all your downloaded media files
history.clear_confirm_body: Completed, failed, and canceled entries are removed from this list. Files you already downloaded are not touched — manage those from the Library page instead.
history.load_failed: Could not load your download history.
history.load_failed_hint: Reopen this tab to try again. If it keeps failing, check the Logs tab.

library.subtitle: Everything this app has downloaded — search it, play it, tidy it up
library.search_placeholder: Search by title or file name…
library.sort_ascending: Sorting smallest first — switch to largest first
library.sort_descending: Sorting largest first — switch to smallest first
library.empty_body: Every file you download lands here automatically. Open the Home tab, paste a link, and download something to get started.
library.no_results_body: Nothing in the library matches everything you asked for at once. Try a shorter search term, a wider date range, or drop one of the filters.
library.rename_description: The file is currently called {{name}}. The new name is applied to the file on disk as well as to the library.
library.move_description_one: 1 file will be moved. Its entry in the library follows it to the new location.
library.move_description_other: {{count}} files will be moved. Their entries in the library follow them to the new location.
library.delete_description_one: 1 file goes to your system trash, where you can still restore it. It is not erased.
library.delete_description_other: {{count}} files go to your system trash, where you can still restore them. They are not erased.
library.remove_description_one: 1 entry is dropped from the library index. Nothing on disk is touched — if the file turns up again, download it once more to re-index it.
library.remove_description_other: {{count}} entries are dropped from the library index. Nothing on disk is touched — if the files turn up again, download them once more to re-index them.
library.redownload_queued: Added to the download queue again

mediaPlayer.cannot_play_format: This format can't be played in the app. The file itself is fine — open it in your default player.
mediaPlayer.cannot_play_decode: The app couldn't decode this file. It may be incomplete, or use a codec the app doesn't support.
mediaPlayer.cannot_play_network: The app couldn't read this file. It may have moved, or be outside the folders the app is allowed to read.
mediaPlayer.cannot_play_unknown: The app couldn't play this file, and it didn't say why. Try opening it in your default player.
mediaPlayer.open_in_default_app_failed: The system couldn't open this file.

playlistScope.title: This link is a playlist
playlistScope.description_with_count: It contains {{count}} items. Download just this one, or add the whole playlist to the queue?
playlistScope.description_unknown_count: Download just this one, or add the whole playlist to the queue?

playlistDetail.title: Choose videos to download
playlistDetail.description_with_count: This playlist has {{count}} videos. Pick which ones to queue, and whether each one downloads as video or audio.

queue.progress_unknown: Progress unknown — this source does not report a total size

downloadForm.url_placeholder: Paste a YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, X, or SoundCloud link
downloadForm.url_placeholder_multi: Paste one or more links (one per line) — YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, X, SoundCloud
downloadForm.supported_sites_hint: Works with YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, X, SoundCloud, and thousands of other sites yt-dlp supports.
downloadForm.batch_mode_hint: {{count}} links detected — pick below how all of them should be downloaded.
downloadForm.batch_partial_failure: {{count}} link(s) could not be added — see the list above.
downloadForm.batch_quality_hint: Each link gets the best quality its own source actually offers.
downloadForm.dropped_urls_none: No links found in that file
downloadForm.clean_links_hint: Strip the extra characters and keep only the valid links
downloadForm.no_audio_formats: No audio quality options are available for this link.
downloadForm.no_video_qualities: No video quality options are available for this link.
downloadForm.gallery_mode_files_hint: Every image and audio track, as-is
downloadForm.gallery_mode_audio_only_hint: Keep just the background audio, discard images
downloadForm.gallery_mode_images_only_hint: Keep just the images, discard the audio track
downloadForm.gallery_mode_slideshow_hint: Combine the images and audio into one slideshow video
downloadForm.gallery_mode_slideshow_unavailable: No audio track found — merged video isn't available for this link
downloadForm.output_codec_compatibility_hint: H.264 / AAC — plays on virtually every device and TV
downloadForm.output_codec_quality_hint: The best the source has, VP9/AV1 included — smaller files, but older players and many TVs cannot open them
downloadForm.output_conversion_warning_audio: The file will be converted to {{format}} after downloading — that extra step takes time. Choose “Keep source” to skip it.
downloadForm.output_conversion_warning_video: The file will be repackaged into a {{container}} container after downloading — that extra step takes time. Choose “Keep source” to skip it.
downloadForm.output_no_conversion_hint: No conversion runs: the file is saved exactly as the source provides it, so it finishes faster.
downloadForm.output_embed_metadata_hint: Writes the title, artist or channel, source link and upload date into the file. Fields the source does not provide are left empty.
downloadForm.output_embed_cover_art_hint: Saves the thumbnail into the file as its cover image.
downloadForm.output_cover_art_unavailable_wav: WAV has no tag area that can hold a cover image, so this step is skipped — the download still succeeds.
downloadForm.output_cover_art_unavailable_source: Keeping the source format leaves the final container unknown — it may be one that cannot hold cover art, such as WebM — so this step is skipped and the download still succeeds.
downloadForm.subtitles_unknown: Whether this link has subtitles was never checked, so none can be listed here. Preview a single video to see its subtitle languages.
downloadForm.subtitles_none: This link offers no subtitles, so there is nothing to download.
downloadForm.subtitles_auto_note: One of the languages you picked is only available as an automatic machine transcription, so that one will be fetched too — expect mistakes in it.
downloadForm.subtitles_delivery_separate_hint: Written next to the media file. Works with every output format.
downloadForm.subtitles_delivery_embedded_hint: Added to the media file as selectable tracks, so a single file carries everything.
downloadForm.subtitles_embed_unavailable_audio: An audio file has no subtitle track to hold them, so they are saved as separate files instead.
downloadForm.subtitles_embed_unavailable_source: Keeping the source format leaves the final container unknown — it may be one that cannot hold subtitles — so they are saved as separate files instead.
downloadForm.segment_trim_hint: Download only what falls between a start and an end time.
downloadForm.segment_split_chapters_hint: Every chapter also becomes a file of its own, next to the complete one.
downloadForm.segment_chapters_none: This link has no chapter list, so there is nothing to split on.
downloadForm.segment_chapters_unknown: Chapters were never checked for this link, so it cannot be split on them. Preview a single video to see its chapters.
downloadForm.segment_time_hint: Use m:ss or h:mm:ss — or plain seconds. Leave the start empty to begin at the beginning, the end empty to run to the end.
downloadForm.segment_error_empty: Enter a start time, an end time, or both.
downloadForm.segment_error_negative: A time must be a real point in the content, like 1:30.
downloadForm.segment_error_end_before_start: The end time must come after the start time.
downloadForm.segment_error_beyond_duration: The start time is past the end of this content.
downloadForm.segment_accurate_hint: Re-encodes around each cut so it lands on the second you asked for instead of the nearest keyframe. This makes the download take noticeably longer.
downloadForm.presets_update_button: Update with what is on screen
downloadForm.presets_no_default_hint: No preset is the default, so a newly previewed link starts from the standard options.
downloadForm.presets_adjusted_title: The preset did not fit this link exactly:
downloadForm.presets_adjusted_bitrate: This link does not offer {{from}} kbps, so the closest it has — {{to}} kbps — was used instead.
downloadForm.presets_adjusted_bitrate_unavailable: This link publishes no bitrate at all, so the preset's {{from}} kbps was replaced by the best audio it actually has.
downloadForm.presets_adjusted_subtitles_dropped: This link has no subtitles in {{languages}}, so those languages were removed from the selection.
downloadForm.presets_adjusted_subtitles_unavailable: This link has no subtitles at all, so the preset's subtitle languages were cleared.
downloadForm.presets_adjusted_subtitles_not_embeddabl: The chosen output cannot hold a subtitle track, so subtitles will be saved as separate files.
downloadForm.presets_adjusted_chapters_unavailable: This link has no chapters, so it will be downloaded as one whole file.

logs.description: Recent backend activity — job failures, retries, and fallback decisions. Useful for figuring out why a download didn't behave as expected.

errors.UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM: This link is not from a supported platform.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_ALL_ENGINES: No download engine could read this link. It may not be a media page, or the site may have changed.
errors.ACCESS_DENIED: This content is private, requires login, or is DRM-protected, so it can't be downloaded.
errors.INVALID_QUALITY_OPTION: The selected quality is no longer available for this link. Please preview it again.
errors.PREVIEW_REQUIRED: Please preview the link before downloading.
errors.DOWNLOAD_FAILED: The download failed. Please try again or use a different link.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Network problem. Check your connection — the download will retry automatically.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This item could not be found.
errors.INVALID_JOB_STATE: This action isn't available for the current download state.
errors.MISSING_QUALITY: Please choose a quality before downloading.
errors.FILE_UNREADABLE: That file could not be read.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: That file is too large — a URL list must be under 5 MB.
errors.FILE_NOT_TEXT: That file isn't readable text, so it can't hold a URL list.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.PRESET_NAME_TAKEN: A preset with that name already exists. Pick a different name.
errors.PRESET_NAME_REQUIRED: Give the preset a name before saving it.
errors.FILE_EXISTS: A file with that name is already there, so nothing was changed — the existing file was not overwritten. Pick a different name or folder.
errors.TRASH_FAILED: The file could not be moved to the system trash, so it was left exactly where it is.
errors.INVALID_FILE_NAME: That name has no characters the filesystem can store. Choose another one.
errors.NOT_A_FILE: That path is a folder, not a file. Point at the file itself.
errors.EMPTY_PLAYLIST: Select at least one file before exporting a playlist.

compliance.title: Before you start downloading
compliance.body: Only download content you own or have permission to use. You are responsible for complying with copyright law and each platform's Terms of Service. This app does not support bypassing DRM or accessing private/paid content.
